# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(lme4)
  library(lmerTest)
  library(broom.mixed)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyr)
  library(knitr)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
adni_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR")
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
adni_save_dir <- file.path(
  adni_dir, "analysis_results", "only_amyloid_positive_2_stage_approach"
)
```

# Get Signif Probes

```{r get_signif}
hrs_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", "interact_mQTLs_inputs.csv")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(CpG = "cpgs", Sources_HRS = "Sources")
adni_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(adni_save_dir, "comb-p-DMRs", "MCI_mQTLs_inputs.csv")
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(.data$IQR_include == 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(CpG = "cpgs", Sources_ADNI = "Sources")

signif_df <- hrs_df %>%
  dplyr::full_join(adni_df, by = "CpG") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dataset = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(.data$Sources_HRS) ~ "ADNI",
      is.na(.data$Sources_ADNI) ~ "HRS",
      TRUE ~ "Both"
    )
  )
```

# Get Probe Statistics

```{r get_stats}
hrs_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(save_dir, "linear_model", "EAP_stats_bacon_interact.csv")
)
adni_df <- read.csv(
  file.path(adni_save_dir, "linear_model_MCI", "PHC_stats_bacon_interact.csv")
)
```

# Merge Results

```{r merge}
annot_df <- hrs_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "CpG",
    "Chr",
    "Position",
    "GREAT_annotation",
    "UCSC_RefGene_Name",
    "UCSC_RefGene_Group",
    "Relation_to_Island"
  ) %>%
  # Add an empty column for easier visual separation
  dplyr::mutate(
    ` ` = ""
  )

hrs_df <- hrs_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "CpG",
    estimate_HRS = "estimate_bacon",
    std_err_HRS = "std_error_bacon",
    pvalue_HRS = "pvalue_bacon",
    fdr_HRS = "fdr_bacon",
    IAR_HRS = "IQR",
    fdr_exclude_iqr_lt2_HRS = "fdr_exclude_iqr_lt2_bacon"
  ) %>%
  # Add an empty column for easier visual separation
  dplyr::mutate(
    `  ` = ""
  )

adni_df <- adni_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "CpG",
    estimate_ADNI = "estimate_bacon",
    std_err_ADNI = "std_error_bacon",
    pvalue_ADNI = "pvalue_bacon",
    fdr_ADNI = "fdr_bacon",
    IAR_ADNI = "IQR",
    fdr_exclude_iqr_lt2_ADNI = "fdr_exclude_iqr_lt2_bacon"
  )

merge_df <- signif_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    annot_df,
    by = "CpG",
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    hrs_df,
    by = "CpG",
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    adni_df,
    by = "CpG",
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  )
```

# Plot

```{r plot, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 8}
add_annotation <- function(p, plot_df) {
  # Calculate Spearman correlation and its two-sided P-value
  cor_result <- stats::cor.test(
    plot_df$estimate_ADNI, plot_df$estimate_HRS, method = "spearman"
  )

  # Create the annotation text
  stats_label <- sprintf(
    "Spearman \u03c1 = %.3f\nTwo-sided P = %.2f \u00d7 10\u207b\u2074\nn = %d CpGs",
    unname(cor_result$estimate),
    cor_result$p.value / 1e-4,
    nrow(plot_df)
  )

  p +
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "label",
      x = 7.75,
      y = 1.33,
      label = stats_label,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 5.2,
      lineheight = 1.3,
      color = text_color,
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 0.4,
      label.padding = grid::unit(0.4, "lines"),
      label.r = grid::unit(0.4, "lines")
    )
}

add_scales <- function(p, plot_df) {
  p +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-8, 8, by = 2)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5),
      labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-9.4, 8.2),
      ylim = c(-1.12, 1.42),
      expand = FALSE
    ) +
    # Titles and caption
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "CpG effect estimates in ADNI and HRS",
      x = "estimate_ADNI",
      y = "estimate_HRS",
      caption = paste0(
        "Each point represents one CpG. All ",
        nrow(plot_df),
        " complete pairs are shown."
      )
    )
}

adjust_theme <- function(p) {
  p +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 17) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 22,
        face = "bold",
        color = text_color,
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 22)
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 19,
        color = text_color
      ),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(
        margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 14)
      ),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(
        margin = ggplot2::margin(r = 14)
      ),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 16,
        color = "#455369"
      ),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(
        color = axis_color,
        linewidth = 0.55
      ),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(
        color = axis_color,
        linewidth = 0.55
      ),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(7, "pt"),

      plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 13,
        color = "#68758A",
        hjust = 0.5,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 14)
      ),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(
        t = 25,
        r = 24,
        b = 12,
        l = 25
      )
    )
}

generate_initial_plot <- function(plot_df) {
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = estimate_ADNI, y = estimate_HRS)
  ) +
    # Dashed reference lines at zero
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = line_color,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = line_color,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    # Blue scatterplot points with subtle white outlines
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      shape = 21,
      fill = point_blue,
      color = "white",
      size = 3,
      stroke = 0.3,
      alpha = 0.95
    )

  p
}

generate_comparison_plot <- function(plot_df) {
  p <- generate_initial_plot(plot_df) %>%
    add_annotation(plot_df) %>%
    add_scales(plot_df) %>%
    adjust_theme()

  p
}

# Colors
point_blue <- "#5084A3"
text_color <- "#263244"
axis_color <- "#69778D"
line_color <- "#91A0B2"

p <- generate_comparison_plot(merge_df)

p
```

# Filter HRS CpGs Replicated in ADNI

Counts reported in the Results, and the CpGs in Supplementary Table 11:
HRS-selected CpGs whose DNAm x pTau interaction in ADNI is nominally
significant (P < 0.05) with the same direction as in HRS. CpGs in DMRs are
kept regardless of their individual HRS P-value.

```{r filter}
compare_df <- merge_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$estimate_HRS),
    !is.na(.data$estimate_ADNI)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    same_direction = sign(.data$estimate_HRS) == sign(.data$estimate_ADNI)
  )

hrs_selected_df <- compare_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data$Sources_HRS))

filtered_df <- hrs_selected_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$same_direction,
    .data$pvalue_ADNI < 0.05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-"same_direction")

count_df <- data.frame(
  group = c(
    "All selected CpGs (either study)",
    "HRS-selected CpGs",
    "HRS-selected, ADNI P < 0.05 and same direction"
  ),
  n = c(nrow(compare_df), nrow(hrs_selected_df), nrow(filtered_df)),
  same_direction = c(
    sum(compare_df$same_direction),
    sum(hrs_selected_df$same_direction),
    nrow(filtered_df)
  )
)

knitr::kable(count_df)
knitr::kable(table(filtered_df$Sources_HRS), col.names = c("Sources_HRS", "n"))
```

write.csv(

write.csv(

  file = file.path(save_dir, "ADNI", "ADNI_HRS_Filtered.csv"),

)
